scope: Original 2017 base/core, all nine original species including Faderan reverse, accepted printed original components and the two contemporaneous direct primary designer clarifications. Remastered, expansions and optional variants excluded.

read_only_review_inputs: Original authorities and specifically allowed original-component/designer provenance listed below

scope_interpretation_receipts: Concrete application outcomes exercise their governing rule. Full formula/algorithm, physical slide method, separately narrated simultaneity, and unmoved remainders are not extra gates unless asked.

Q02 seven-point result, Q10 three-point scoring, Q12 mixed wild output, Q16 three/two split, Q38 three-point ceiling result, Q41 eight-point entry, Q50 shortage result, Q53 split purchase/pass and Q55 half-point combination are accepted without additionally narrated general methods.
Q55.F01 is satisfied by confirming the particular two-small-plus-ship group, together with the stated half point in F02; do not demand a separately narrated generic grouping formula.
Q16.F02 is satisfied by three-and-two; do not separately demand the words as evenly as possible.
Correct context is permitted and false material context still fails; contextual facts were independently truth-checked but not counted as tested procedure.

affected_map_units: Printed card entry symbols and actual output previews
Faderan shuffled hidden deck, one shared converter once, printed4-white/jungle cost, ordinary loans
source_references: Booklet p2 How Cards Enter Play, fourth (deck) symbol
Faderan front Relic Worlds, sentence identifying play of the top card
coverage_findings.source_truth: Running the relic-deck converter puts the top card of the relic deck into play during Trade. It is not a choice of any relic or a draw into an unplayed hand. Entry is the converter consequence.
coverage_findings.why_existing_questions_do_not_test_it: Q14 asks one-versus-many activations, phase, preparation, second-draw permission and cost. Q36 asks exact inputs and consumed-colony destination; its top-relic-entry sentence is explicitly context. Q26 asks the different self-entry symbol exception. Q37/Q38/Q41/Q62 stipulate a relic already played/entered and ask its effects, so do not test this entry procedure.
coverage_findings.why_consequential_and_novel: It determines both which card is available and whether its in-play abilities and entry effects begin now. This is the distinct deck-output entry rule printed beside its own icon, rather than another numeric output, renamed scenario, or physical restatement of a rule already asked.

proposed_question.question: After Faderan pays the ordinary relic-deck converter during Trade, which relic is put into play? May Faderan choose another card from that deck or keep the resulting relic out of play for later instead?
proposed_question.expected_answer: Put the top card of the relic deck into play immediately. Do not choose another card or hold that card out of play for later.

required_facts.fact: The top relic-deck card is the card put into play; no choosing another relic.
That card enters play on resolving the converter during Trade, rather than being held out of play for later.

contextual_background: Converter costs and activation limits, and individual entry rewards, are separately tested and are not additional omission gates here.

coverage_findings.fix_boundary: Add a new focused question/key/asked-fact entry and map it. Keep Q14/Q26/Q36 wording and omission gates unchanged; do not promote their context to required facts.
